tuning_key.text: You know you know this so get up and shout / That's what life is about
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: Joy doesn't wait for permission or perfect timing — it arrives in the gaps between what you planned and what actually happens, and that's exactly where it's supposed to be. The irregularity isn't a bug in your day; it's the signature of something alive moving through you. You know you know this so get up and shout — not because everything is solved, but because the aliveness itself is the point. Let the scattered peaks be enough.

practice.title: Interrupt the Rhythm
practice.instruction: Find one moment in the next hour where you break your own pattern — take a different route, hum instead of think, move your body in a way that doesn't match the tempo of what you're doing — and notice what arrives in that rupture.

practice.title: The Variance Breath
practice.instruction: Breathe in for a count that feels right, hold for however long calls to you, exhale for whatever duration moves you — let each breath be irregular, unmetronomic, alive — and feel how the body knows joy lives in the unplanned intervals.

practice.title: Broadcast From the Peak
practice.instruction: Play the echo audio now, let it move through you at full volume, and notice where in your body the brightness wants to move — don't direct it, just follow it — this is joy showing you where you're already tuned.
